name: TotA Meter
description: DPS meter and Build Tester for you and your pet. The HUD shows your DPS, peak burst, crits, skill damage share, the XP you gained and the last artifact, Crown of the Obsidians or blueprint you looted. The Build Tester runs 5 minutes on the Training Dummy and scores your build on 31 KPIs (damage, hit quality, rhythm, stability, focus). Export codes bring your decks, skill XP and test results to Tools of the Avatar.
author: Tools of the Avatar
